Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body:
Can each anarch only burn one blood for a vote with Rant! or can they burn as many as they like?

Name: Rant!
[Anarchs:C/PAB3]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Requires a ready anarch. Only usable during a referendum before any votes are cast.
During this referendum, each ready anarch may burn 1 blood to gain 1 additional vote. If the referendum fails, this acting vampire takes 2 unpreventable damage.
Artist: Steve Prescott

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
During X, Do A to gain B...

Once per X they can do A to gain B, ergo: every anarch can do it just once.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: Malachy
Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Malachy wrote:
> Can one play Mob Rule when the results of a vote are tallied to restart voting so to speak? Or "When the result are tallied" phrase is the absolute end and no more modifiers can be played?
>
This doesn't really make sense.
We start tallying the results when everyone has skipped. You can count before that, but tallying the results will only determine whether the referendum is successful or fails...

You can't "restart the voting" - when votes are cast, they can't change :
Rulebook 6.3.3 wrote:
>
> Once cast, a vote or a ballot cannot be changed.
>
